slides.label: Verse 1
lines: With the glory-garment of our priestly calling
We offer our sacrifice of praise
In Your holy sanctuary, we your living temples
We offer our sacrifice of praise

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: With the calves of our lips and the lifting of our hands
We honour You, great God
You’re the God of our fathers,
The Apostles and Prophets

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Unto You, we give all the glory
Honour and blessings, oh Lord
Worthy of power and might, Holy Lamb of God

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: You’re the rock of our strength
The great high Priest of our
calling and salvation

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Our high fortress and stronghold
You’re the God of faithfulness

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: Our hearts are filled
with continuous thanksgiving to You Lord
Your favour to us is endless
Our hearts are filled with ecstatic joy
That keeps us singing Your praise
